xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4998: Keep agent scratch files out of /tmp so a reboot doesn't delete them

plan.title: Keep agent scratch files out of /tmp so a reboot doesn't delete them
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: Claude Code keeps each managed session's scratchpad under /tmp/claude-<uid>/<encoded-cwd>/<session-uuid>/. Ubuntu's tmpfiles.d rule 'D /tmp 1777 root root 30d' empties /tmp at every boot, so a reboot on 2026-11-03 deleted an orchestrator's published-page source and 30 screenshots. Overdeck sets neither CLAUDE_CODE_TMPDIR nor TMPDIR for managed launches, and no rule tells agents to avoid /tmp.
narratives.Proposal: Add src/lib/agent-tmpdir.ts (getAgentTmpDir() = <OVERDECK_HOME>/tmp, and a launcher line that runs mkdir -p + chmod 700 + export CLAUDE_CODE_TMPDIR). generateLauncherScript() pushes that line in its existing non-remote block, so every local managed launch (conversations, work/review/test/plan agents, handoffs, workers, resumes) gets it. A new Deacon hygiene routine (src/lib/cloister/agent-tmp-sweep.ts, hourly) removes session directories at <root>/claude-<uid>/<project>/<session-uuid>/ whose newest mtime is older than 14 days and whose uuid is not in any live agent's sessions.json; a null backend inventory or a global Deacon pause skips the pass. pan doctor gains an 'Agent scratch' size line that warns above 10 GiB. A universal bundled rule no-tmp-scratch tells agents to keep files out of /tmp. configuration/harnesses.mdx documents the location, variable, cleanup and doctor line.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Moving or migrating existing /tmp/claude-<uid> contents.
- Setting TMPDIR for any harness (Claude Code, codex, pi or others).
- Removing loose files in claude-<uid>/, the background-ai/ directory, or anything other than depth-3 session directories.
- Changing systemd-tmpfiles configuration or making /tmp persistent.
- Config keys for the 14-day window or the 10 GiB threshold.
- Exporting CLAUDE_CODE_TMPDIR in remote (Fly) launchers.
- Rewriting launcher scripts of sessions that are already running.
- Adding harness-name comparisons (harness === '...') in src/.
- Raising any row in scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt.

autoDecisions.summary: Export CLAUDE_CODE_TMPDIR in every non-remote launcher regardless of harness.
autoDecisions.rationale: Non-Claude harnesses ignore the variable and any Claude Code child they start benefits; a harness branch would trip the lint:harness-branches ratchet.

autoDecisions.summary: Set TMPDIR for no harness, including codex and pi.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue forbids it for Claude Code. Codex keeps sessions in a per-agent CODEX_HOME and pi in piSessionDir, both under ~/.overdeck/agents/<id>/, so their state already survives a reboot; moving all their build temp output onto a 98%-full home disk would be worse.

autoDecisions.summary: Liveness = listLiveAgentIds() backend inventory plus the session ids recorded in those agents' sessions.json.
autoDecisions.rationale: A session directory carries only a Claude session uuid, and liveness.ts isAlive() needs an agent id. Reading sessions.json for the ~10 live agents is cheap, matches the oracle transcript-retention.ts uses for deletion, errs toward keeping (a pane with only its shell left still counts as live), and a null inventory skips the pass.

autoDecisions.summary: Session directories are the depth-3 entries <root>/claude-<uid>/<encoded-project>/<session-uuid>/, not top-level entries.
autoDecisions.rationale: A probe with CLAUDE_CODE_TMPDIR set on 2026-11-04 created exactly that layout; ~/.overdeck/tmp also already holds background-ai/, which must not be swept.

autoDecisions.summary: 14 days and 10 GiB are constants; the sweep runs hourly.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue fixes both values and asks for no knob; hourly matches the transcript retention sweep.

autoDecisions.summary: Doctor measures size with async execFile('du', ['-sk', root]) and a 30 s timeout.
autoDecisions.rationale: du is faster than a Node walk on a large tree, exists on Linux and macOS, and async keeps the call safe if doctor code is ever reached from the server.

autoDecisions.summary: Docs go in configuration/harnesses.mdx plus one codebase-map line; context-layers docs stay unchanged.
autoDecisions.rationale: Neither configuration/context-layers.mdx nor docs/CONTEXT-LAYERS.md lists individual bundled rules, so adding a rule does not change them.

metadata.sizeJustification: Seven small vertical items across launcher, cloister, doctor, rules and docs; the launcher export without the sweep would grow ~/.overdeck/tmp without bound, so the pieces ship together.

items.title: Add agent-tmpdir module with getAgentTmpDir and the launcher line

narrative.Action: Follow PRD work item W1. Create src/lib/agent-tmpdir.ts as a leaf module importing only node:path, ./paths.js (getOverdeckHome) and ./shell-quote.js. Export AGENT_TMP_RETENTION_DAYS = 14, getAgentTmpDir() returning join(getOverdeckHome(), 'tmp') at call time, and agentTmpdirLauncherLine(dir = getAgentTmpDir()) returning `mkdir -p <q> && chmod 700 <q> && export CLAUDE_CODE_TMPDIR=<q>` where <q> = shellQuote(dir). The line must contain no '$'. Add src/lib/__tests__/agent-tmpdir.test.ts covering the OVERDECK_HOME override, the exact string for '/a b/tmp', and running the line through bash (async execFile) against a mkdtemp dir whose tmp child pre-exists at 0775.

items.title: Given OVERDECK_HOME=/x/home, getAgentTmpDir() returns /x/home/tmp
agentTmpdirLauncherLine('/a b/tmp') returns exactly mkdir -p '/a b/tmp' && chmod 700 '/a b/tmp' && export CLAUDE_CODE_TMPDIR='/a b/tmp'
Given a pre-existing 0775 directory, running the line in bash applies mode 0700 and the shell prints CLAUDE_CODE_TMPDIR equal to that path

Add the agent tmp sweep that removes idle, non-live session directories

expected_outputs: agent-dir-removal guard passes (no rm/rmdir line mentions an AGENTS_DIR-derived variable)

narrative.Action: Follow PRD work item W3 exactly (deps interface, 9-step algorithm, test list). Model the module on src/lib/cloister/transcript-retention.ts: injectable deps (readDir with withFileTypes, lstat, realpath, removeTree via rm recursive+force, removeEmptyDir via rmdir, readSessionsIndex reading <agentsDir>/<id>/sessions.json, listLiveAgentIds from src/lib/terminal-backends/inventory.ts, isPaused = isDeaconGloballyPaused from src/lib/overdeck/control-settings.ts, now, log). Only depth-3 directories under claude-<digits>/<dir>/ are candidates; never follow symlinks; require realpath containment with exactly three segments before removal. Live session ids come from JSON lines' sessionId fields in live agents' sessions.json, read once per pass. Tests use vi.useFakeTimers() + vi.setSystemTime(), real fs in mkdtemp, and utimes for mtimes; never real waits. Use only node:fs/promises (no sync child processes). scripts/guard-agent-dir-removal.sh flags any rm/rmdir line that mentions AGENTS_DIR or a variable derived from it: keep the sessions.json reader (the only AGENTS_DIR user) in its own function whose variables never appear on a line that calls rm or rmdir, and run npm run lint:agent-dir-removal.

items.title: Given a session dir claude-1000/-proj/<uuid>/ whose newest file is 15 days old and whose uuid is in no live agent's sessions.json, the sweep removes it and returns an action naming 1 removed directory
Given a 15-day-old session dir whose uuid is recorded in a live agent's sessions.json, or one containing a file modified 1 day ago, the sweep preserves it
Given listLiveAgentIds returns null, the sweep preserves every directory and returns the 'Agent tmp sweep skipped' action; given isPaused returns true, it returns [] without reading the root
Given background-ai/, a loose file in claude-1000/ and a symlink at session depth pointing outside the root, each survives a sweep unchanged and the symlink target is preserved
Run the agent tmp sweep hourly from the hygiene scheduler

narrative.Action: Follow PRD work item W4. In src/lib/cloister/hygiene-scheduler.ts add the import of sweepAgentTmpDirs, a constant AGENT_TMP_SWEEP_INTERVAL_MS = 60 * 60_000 with a PAN-4998 comment, and the routine row ['sweepAgentTmpDirs', () => sweepAgentTmpDirs(), AGENT_TMP_SWEEP_INTERVAL_MS] next to sweepTranscriptRetention. In tests/unit/lib/cloister/hygiene-scheduler.test.ts add sweepAgentTmpDirs to the hoisted mocks and a vi.mock for '../../../../src/lib/cloister/agent-tmp-sweep.js' (without it the test runs the real sweep on the real home), assert one call at start, and add an hourly-cadence case mirroring the transcript-retention case at line 177 using vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync.

items.title: Given startHygieneScheduler() runs, sweepAgentTmpDirs is called exactly once immediately
Given 60 minutes elapse via vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(60 * 60_000), the scheduler sends one more sweepAgentTmpDirs call, and after stopHygieneScheduler() no further call is made
Report agent scratch size in pan doctor and warn above 10 GiB

narrative.Action: Follow PRD work item W5. Create src/cli/commands/doctor-agent-tmp.ts re-declaring CheckResult (like doctor-inotify.ts), exporting AGENT_TMP_WARN_BYTES = 10 * 1024 ** 3 and checkAgentTmp({ root?, exists?, measureBytes? }) with default measureBytes = promisify(execFile)('du', ['-sk', root], { timeout: 30_000 }) → parseInt(stdout) * 1024. Name 'Agent scratch (~/.overdeck/tmp)'. Results: absent root → ok 'not created yet'; ≤ 10 GiB → ok '<size> in <root>'; > 10 GiB → warn '<size> in <root> (over 10 GiB)' with the fix text from the PRD; measure throws → warn 'could not measure: <message>'. Sizes print as 'x.y GiB' at ≥ 1 GiB, else 'n MiB'. Wire it in src/cli/commands/doctor.ts with one import and `for (const c of await checkAgentTmp()) checks.push(c); // PAN-4998` beside the checkInotify line (line 905). Tests inject exists/measureBytes for all four results.

items.title: Given measureBytes returns 11 GiB, checkAgentTmp returns one result with status warn whose message includes 'over 10 GiB'
Given measureBytes returns 1 GiB, checkAgentTmp returns status ok with message '1.0 GiB in <root>'; given the root is absent, it returns ok 'not created yet' without calling measureBytes
Given measureBytes throws, checkAgentTmp returns status warn with message starting 'could not measure:'
Running pan doctor from the built branch prints a line containing 'Agent scratch'
Add the universal no-tmp-scratch bundled rule

narrative.Action: Follow PRD work item W6. Create sync-sources/rules/no-tmp-scratch.md with exactly the frontmatter and text given in the PRD (scope: universal; title '### Keep files you may need later out of `/tmp`'; one short paragraph). Name no pan verb. Add a test to tests/lib/context-layers/rules.test.ts asserting readBundledRules() includes a rule named no-tmp-scratch with scope universal and renderBundledRules('claude-code', false) contains 'Keep files you may need later out of'. After merge, `pan sync` puts it into ~/.overdeck/context/claude-global.md.

items.title: readBundledRules() returns a rule named no-tmp-scratch whose scope is universal
renderBundledRules('claude-code', false) produces output that contains 'Keep files you may need later out of' and the rule's source path
Document the scratch directory in the harness docs and codebase map

narrative.Action: Follow PRD work item W7. In configuration/harnesses.mdx, inside '### Claude Code (default)' directly before '#### Claude Code version requirements', add '#### Scratch directory' in plain prose stating: managed Claude Code sessions keep their scratchpad under ~/.overdeck/tmp/claude-<uid>/ because Overdeck sets CLAUDE_CODE_TMPDIR=~/.overdeck/tmp (mode 0700) in every local launch; /tmp is emptied at boot on many Linux distributions; TMPDIR is unchanged so build tools still use /tmp; Fly launches are unchanged; the Deacon checks hourly and removes a session's directory once nothing in it has changed for 14 days and no live agent owns the session; pan doctor shows the folder size and warns above 10 GiB; Codex and pi already keep session state under ~/.overdeck/agents/. In .overdeck/context/codebase/architecture.md add one line after the launcher-generator.ts bullet naming src/lib/agent-tmpdir.ts and cloister/agent-tmp-sweep.ts, and keep exactly one <!-- last-verified: --> line at the end, updated. Leave configuration/context-layers.mdx and docs/CONTEXT-LAYERS.md unchanged (they list no individual rules).
